name: firstpass
description: Confidence-gated model routing for coding agents — run every unit of work at the cheapest model that can pass verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route every task to the cheapest model that can pass verification
interface.longDescription: A six-flag rubric assigns a base tier (cheap/standard/frontier/apex). Objective evidence — verification failure, disagreement between low-tier runs, an uncertainty flag — is the only thing allowed to escalate it, never predicted difficulty. Measured up to −95% cost on public benchmarks (GSM8K, HumanEval) at equal-or-better pass rate.
defaultPrompt: Apply the Undercut routing policy to this batch of work.
What tier would the six-flag rubric assign this task, and why?
Read skills/firstpass/SKILL.md and follow it for the rest of this session.
